best_num = 0
best_den = 1

    if error1 < min_error or (error1 == min_error and (i < best_den or (i == best_den and num_candidate < best_num))):

        best_den = i
    if error2 < min_error or (error2 == min_error and (i < best_den or (i == best_den and num_candidate + 1 < best_num))):
        min_error = error2
        best_num = num_candidate + 1
        best_den = i
    if num_candidate > 0:
        error3 = abs((num_candidate - 1.0) / i - ratio)
        if error3 < min_error or (error3 == min_error and (i < best_den or (i == best_den and num_candidate - 1 < best_num))):
            min_error = error3
            best_num = num_candidate - 1
            best_den = i

print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
